questions.question: Who has proposed this or something structurally equivalent before?
questions.delta: Direct prior art now includes ZhuziYulei92 and Hegesh2025 pp163–164 n60–61. The same modal tonic proposal is known; no historical novelty claimed.

questions.question: What fields study this problem?
questions.delta: Historical Chinese musicology, textual/commentarial criticism, modal transformation analysis and exact constraint compatibility are participating fields.

questions.question: What terminology do those fields use for it?
questions.delta: Distinguish 聲/音 (tone/sound), 調 (mode), 均/context, named律standard, modal final, generationorder and useorder; retain source spellings.

questions.question: What are the closest established theories, models, equations, or frameworks?
questions.delta: Test fixed-offset onecontext model against a source-conditioned separate-mode inverse-tonic adapter; retain positive-family origin and register parameters.

questions.question: What reviews, surveys, bibliographies, encyclopedias, dissertations, or meta-analyses map the space?
questions.delta: Hegesh bibliography and notes expose further disputes (ChenHongyin2018; Falkenhausen1993). Those referenced originals remain uninspected.

questions.question: What are the canonical papers, books, and authors?
questions.delta: Inspected sources: Zheng/Jia in receivedZhouLi22; ZhuziYulei92 revision1540612; Lam2024 originalarticle/figures; Hegesh2025 originalresearch. No earliest manuscript dating established.

questions.question: What are the competing explanations?
questions.delta: Competing interpretations remain: Zheng/Jia generation/exclusion/coarseness, later four-piece/modal reading, and modern conditional reconstruction. A mathematical fit doesnot elect historical intention.

questions.question: What has been falsified, criticized, or abandoned?
questions.delta: The minimal3equation fixed-context adapter is unsatisfiable; a separate-mode adapter survives. This localizes the incompatible assumption ratherthan falsifying the entiretradition.

questions.question: What are the unresolved questions?
questions.delta: Original performance structure, full source semantics, chronological transfer and linguistic sound intentions remain unresolved. LiteralYize fraction727 versus ideal729 is a separate textual discrepancy.

questions.question: What primary sources or datasets are important to the field?
questions.delta: New hashed Zhu92 text, Lam figures, Hegesh officialrepository PDF and7 checked pipe-length spans support this bounded test; no ancientaudio acquired.

questions.question: What earlier historical traditions have scholars already connected to it?
questions.delta: Later Zhu interpretation directly cites the ancestralZhouLi prescription. Its disagreement with the receivedcommentary is retained as interpretive ancestry, not evidenceoforiginalperformance.

questions.question: Has terminology changed over time in ways that hide older versions?
questions.delta: Mode-versus-tone and final-versus-scale-position readings change the unitofanalysis. Do not erase this through an Englishrole label orautomatic cross-period nomenclature.

questions.delta: The incompatibility certificate uses ordinary modular equation/cycle consistency; the inverse-tonic operation reuses knownmodal analysis. Contribution is local executable source/model accounting.
